redact_runs.title: HR grievance memorandum
redact_runs.input: This memorandum concerns the grievance brought by Dr. Eleanor Whitcombe, a consultant cardiologist, against St. Andrew's Regional Hospital Trust. On 4 February 2021, Dr. Whitcombe lodged a formal complaint (Ref. HR-2021-0847) with the Trust's board, chaired by Mr. Harold Beecham. After internal mediation failed, the matter was referred to the Employment Tribunal in Manchester (Case no. 2402319/2021). Whitcombe was represented by Patel & Rosenthal LLP; the Trust instructed Carrow Chambers.

redact_runs.title: Cross-border settlement note
redact_runs.input: Anya Kowalski of Meridian Capital Partners met with Tomás Ferreira, general counsel of Halcyon Biotech GmbH, in Frankfurt on 12 March 2022 to finalise the settlement under Application no. 41872/19. Ms Kowalski confirmed that payment of EUR 4.2 million would be wired to the account held at Banco Nacional de Lisboa (IBAN PT50 0002 0123 1234 5678 9015 4).
